overview: 2026年，Solarvest Holdings Berhad 通过私募配售认购 Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad 45,000,000 股新股（占扩大后股本 6.60%），代价 RM12.38 million，成为其主要股东；同时与 Vista Contracting and Investment Global Pte. Ltd. 及 FBG Land Sdn. Bhd. 的谅解备忘录仍在讨论中，年内多次更新状态。公司未公告新增或退出业务线。
overview_en: In 2026, Solarvest Holdings Berhad subscribed to 45,000,000 new ordinary shares in Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad (6.60% of enlarged share capital) for a total cash consideration of RM12.38 million via private placement, becoming a substantial shareholder; meanwhile, its MOUs with Vista Contracting and Investment Global Pte. Ltd. and FBG Land Sdn. Bhd. remain under discussion with status updates during the year. No new or exited business lines were announced.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 年内完成对 Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad 的私募配售认购，并持续更新与 Vista 及 FBG Land 的谅解备忘录状态。
segments.note_en: Completed private placement subscription in Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad and continued to update the status of MOUs with Vista and FBG Land during the year.

actions.text: 更新与 Vista Contracting and Investment Global Pte. Ltd. 及 FBG Land Sdn. Bhd. 的谅解备忘录状态，双方仍在讨论潜在战略合作。
